whoTheyAre.summary: This profile covers the specific PeopleGroups.org record named Javanese Transmigrants in Indonesia, not all Javanese people. UNESCO material supplies broad Javanese cultural context from Yogyakarta and is not used to infer every transmigrant community's practices.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies this specific source record under Sunni Islam. The category is not generalized to all Javanese people or every person associated with this record.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: This profile explains the current provider classification with mission-status and language-resource evidence. Javanese identity, migration history, culture or Islam is not treated as the cause of unreached status.

whyUnreached.heading: Current mission-status evidence
whyUnreached.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently reports the Javanese Transmigrants record below its evangelical threshold with no active church-planting activity in the GSEC label.

whyUnreached.heading: Javanese-language resources are documented
whyUnreached.summary: The provider lists Javanese Bible and film resources, so the profile keeps resource availability separate from mission-status classification.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org identifies PG046650 / PEID 46650 as Javanese Transmigrants in Indonesia with Javanese (jav) as the primary language; UNESCO documents Yogyakarta as a continuing centre of Javanese cultural traditions.
claims.interpretationNote: The UNESCO source gives broad Javanese cultural context and does not establish the history, practices or location of every community represented by PG046650.

claims.text: UNESCO describes Yogyakarta's historic axis and living institutions as exceptional testimony to Javanese civilisation and continuing cultural traditions including arts, literature, ceremonies and festivals.
claims.interpretationNote: This is broad cultural context centered on Yogyakarta, not a claim that all Javanese Transmigrant communities share identical practices.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies PG046650 under Sunni Islam.
claims.interpretationNote: This is an aggregate source-record classification, not an individual-level religious claim.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently labels PG046650 'Less than 2% Evangelical, No Active CP Activity.'
claims.interpretationNote: This is the provider's current mission-status label for this exact source record.

claims.text: The PeopleGroups.org profile lists Javanese-language Bible resources and film resources including JESUS and The Savior variants.
claims.interpretationNote: Resource listings do not establish distribution, comprehension, use, or Scripture translation completeness.
